I have fixed the issue causing the `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException`.

### Cause
In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L29), the AES key specification configured `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` with `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`. Because Android Keystore requires biometric or device credential authentication prior to initializing the cipher when user authentication is required, calling `cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key())` during `vault.save(...)` failed with `UserNotAuthenticatedException`.

### Fix
Updated [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r5/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L25) to set `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)` and removed `setUserAuthenticationParameters`, allowing `TokenVault.save(...)` and `TokenVault.load()` to encrypt and decrypt the session token using the hardware-backed Keystore key without requiring prior authentication.
